item.title: Type 2 diabetes linked to 53% higher Alzheimer’s risk, major review finds
item.description: [Diabetes & Kidney Disease] Keyword: type 2 diabetes — People with type 2 diabetes face a 53% higher risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease, according to a major new review of 40 studies. Researchers estimate that nearly five out of every 1,000 people with type 2 diabetes develop Alzheimer’s each year. By focusing specifically on these two conditions, the study offers a clearer understanding of a potentially serious connection between metabolic health and brain health.
